decisions.reason: False: in fully on-screen disclosure "Show handover notes", the leading H/S and the leading n of its wrapped "notes" line have visibly shaved left portions. This is present in original PNGs at multiple scroll offsets, away from viewport edges. Remaining required title/subtitle, notice, service labels/reason/details, summary, visible guidance, action and footer were inspected across the exact-state sweep; no other lost text was found. The approved question explicitly treats visible word clipping as false.

False: the disclosure "Show handover notes" is locally occluded at its curved left boundary: portions of the first letter and of the n on the next line disappear although the control is fully within the viewport. This is boundary occlusion of text, not merely a short wrapped line. The rest of the exact-state sweep shows separated cards, indicators, notes, summary, action and footer without collisions.

attributions.reason: Original fully visible disclosure text is cut by its own curved control boundary at multiple scroll offsets; the host viewport is clear of the affected letters. The production component uses a TextButton with zero content padding and full-width copy at enlarged P2 text. This supports component-owned text masking/occlusion, not a torn capture or scroll-edge artifact. The wrapping and overlap observations describe the same local defect, not independent bugs.
